title: salix humilis var. microphylla
intro:
Salix humilis var. microphylla, commonly known as prairie dwarf willow, is a plant species belonging to the willow family (Salicaceae) and is a small shrub or low-growing tree that is native to North America.

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Salix humilis var. microphylla include its ability to reduce pain, lower fever, and alleviate digestive issues, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.

Note: This plant is not well-studied, and more research is needed to confirm its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
